profile.name: Aria Vale
profile.tagline: I design and build digital experiences that feel alive.
profile.bio: For the past eight years I've been obsessing over the tiny details that make interfaces feel effortless — motion that guides the eye, typography that breathes, and performance that never gets in the way. I work at the intersection of design and engineering, shipping products for startups and studios around the world.

services.title: Product Design
services.description: From rough idea to polished, developer-ready interface. Research, flows, wireframes and high-fidelity UI.

services.title: Frontend Engineering
services.description: Fast, accessible, maintainable frontends built with modern tooling and a keen eye for detail.

services.title: Design Systems
services.description: Scalable component libraries and tokens that keep design and code perfectly in sync.

projects.title: Lumen
projects.subtitle: Adaptive design system
projects.description: A themeable design system powering 12 products, with automated visual regression, tokens sync between Figma and code, and a docs site developers actually enjoy.

projects.title: Pulse
projects.subtitle: Realtime analytics dashboard
projects.description: Streaming analytics for product teams — sub-second charts, cohort explorer, and an query builder that non-analysts can use.

projects.title: Kanto
projects.subtitle: Commerce experience
projects.description: A headless storefront with immersive product pages, AR try-on, and a checkout that converts 34% better than the old one.

projects.title: Sonora
projects.subtitle: Music streaming UI
projects.description: An audio-first interface with a fluid mini-player, gesture navigation, and a waveform seek bar that feels like vinyl.

projects.title: Atlas
projects.subtitle: Travel planner
projects.description: Collaborative trip planning with smart itineraries, offline maps, and a beautiful budget splitter.

projects.title: Verdant
projects.subtitle: Carbon tracking app
projects.description: Turns messy utility data into a clear decarbonisation roadmap with shareable reports for stakeholders.
